research.name: Bull Rush
research.note: Three-lane 3D endless runner in React Three Fiber with neon bloom lighting and deterministic, replay-verified daily courses.

effects: deterministic daily course shared by all players with replay-verified runs
neon green and violet point lights in fog with bloom and vignette post-processing

unverified: The game was not seen running: WebFetch of https://trybullrush.xyz returned only the title text, and no browser was allowed in this session.
The repository has no gameplay screenshots or recordings; the only images viewed (public/og-card.jpg, public/bull-hero.jpg) are promotional key art of a bull, not the game.
Both signature effects were read from the README and src/three/Game.tsx source, not observed rendered.
requiresHostedService is false based on the README stating the API client is offline-safe and the game deploys as a static site; this was not tested.
The README says the production URL serves a pre-migration build, so the live site may differ from the code on main.
